---
title: "Home runs"
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(Lahman)

Teams |>
	filter(yearID %in% c(2019, 1981, 1994, 2020)) |>
	group_by(yearID) |>
	summarize(
		total_home_runs = sum(HR),
		total_team_games = sum(G)
	) |>
	mutate(
		home_runs_per_game = total_home_runs / total_team_games
	) |>
	arrange(yearID)
```
